record.original_title: Que promueve el uso de la inteligencia artificial en favor del desarrollo económico y social del país
record.summary: Chamber of Deputies bill of 20 articles to promote the use of artificial intelligence for the country's economic and social development. It names the Ministry of Information and Communication Technologies (MITIC) as the authority that sets national AI policy and keeps a National Registry of AI Systems. It sets ethical principles on privacy, bias and algorithmic transparency, prohibits AI for indiscriminate surveillance, requires ethics audits of systems that affect fundamental rights, provides sanctions for misuse and a National Committee on AI Ethics and Regulation, and adds incentives and research and education measures.
record.notes: Presented in the Chamber of Deputies in late April or early May 2025; the Chamber's newsletter of 25 Apr to 2 May 2025 reports five sponsors (Gamarra, Abed, Del Puerto, Vázquez and Meza) and the newspaper La Nación of 1 May 2025 lists seven, adding Carlos Núñez Salinas and Johanna Ortega. The newsletter of 2 May 2025 gives the title as 'en favor del desarrollo económico, social, científico y cultural del país'; the Chamber's newsletter of 24 to 31 Oct 2025 and the press give 'económico y social'. The bill went to the Chamber's advisory committees. The Committee on Social Equity and Equal Rights of Men and Women, chaired by Deputy Rocío Abed, convened a public hearing on it for 4 June 2025. In the week of 27 Oct 2025 the national defence committee continued its study and reported that it still awaited the technical opinions of MITIC and the Ministry of the Interior. A separate Senate bill regulating AI systems, presented in May 2025, is PY-01.

judgment.status_reasoning: A bill still in its advisory committees: the Chamber's newsletter of 24 to 31 Oct 2025 says the defence committee continued the study and the bill still awaits the opinions of MITIC and the Ministry of the Interior. No stored source shows a plenary vote, so the status stays Draft / proposed.
judgment.scope_reasoning: Pending AI-specific bill with ethics, rights and anti-misuse provisions; the existing scope_note stands.
